euler_to_quat: build a python module to convert XYZ euler angles to a quaternion using euler_to_quat
quat_to_euler: build a python module to convert a quaternion to ZYX euler angles using quat_to_euler
quat_mul: build a python module to compute the Hamilton product of two quaternions using quat_mul
quat_rotate: build a python module to rotate a 3D vector by a quaternion using quat_rotate
axisangle_to_quat: build a python module to convert an axis-angle representation to a quaternion using axisangle_to_quat
